title: GTA Online Event Week: Last One Before GTA 6 (Nov 12-18)
description: RockstarINTEL reports the November 12-18 GTA Online event week features Kortz Center Heist rewards, double Priority File payouts, casino prizes, test rides and dealer offers.
youtubeTitle: GTA Online event week Nov 12-18: Kortz Center Heist bonuses
socialHook: RockstarINTEL reported that GTA Online's Nov 12-18 event week is the last one before GTA 6.

sections.heading: Kortz Center Heist and Priority File Rewards
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reported that the GTA Online event week running November 12 through November 18 is the last weekly update before GTA 6. The publisher said Rockstar has rotated content and added bonuses, including new Primary Targets for the Kortz Center Heist.

According to RockstarINTEL, the Kortz Center Heist's first-completion bonus will reset, and completing the heist without dying awards an extra GTA$400,000. The FIB Priority File for the week is The Brute Force File, and Priority Files pay double during the event.

sections.heading: Cars, Casino Prizes and Test Rides
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL also listed the week's reward vehicles and dealership offers. Players can try the Weeny Issi Rally as the Premium Test Ride, while the Test Track includes the Übermacht Rebla GTS, Declasse Impaler LX and Obey I-Wagen.

The Lucky Wheel casino prize this week is the Karin Everon, listed by RockstarINTEL at $1,475,000 from Southern San Andreas Super Autos, with GTA+ members receiving two spins per 24 hours. LS Car Meet players who place top four in a race for two days in a row can unlock the Western Powersurge.
